objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, archived, translated, invalidated, reactivated, and evaluated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type of a document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction or work instruction.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of a document type used in document identifiers.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to a document identifier.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of a document within its status network or workflow.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document by TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which a document version is valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the Valid Until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date on which document validity expires.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version of a document used for translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which an authorized reader can view a released language version.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or on which new documents can be generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system to create a new document or to add additional information or attachment to a document.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data such as IT applications that documents can be linked with.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person using the system and participating in document management processes.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Implemented role available to users in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for roles, authorizations, readership, distribution, archive access, and business administration.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change right assigned to a group or person for a document.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants in release, acknowledgement, validity extension, override, reactivation, or translation workflows.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: Functionality supporting complete traceability.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, automatically released with the main document, subject to versioning, and archived with the main document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Object supplementing a document, released and published directly via switches in properties, and not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

objs.name: equipment
objs.description: Relevant equipment used to describe documents in more detail.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for an existing document that belongs to a document and can be scheduled, edited, completed, and displayed in the document.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when validity is close to expiry and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created for a document to declare it out of force and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of User Groups and persons assigned to distribution for a document.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard listing relevant documents and information for users.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report or search available for documents, instructions, workflow status, acknowledgements, or revision cycle.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Email sent by the system to inform users about workflow tasks, released versions, change proposals, validity extension, override, or acknowledgements.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more templates defined for the document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploading files or generating new documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: maintain_document_attribute
evts.description: Maintain attributes such as references, IT applications, relevant companies or areas of validity via document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: print_document_metadata
evts.description: Automatically print defined metadata in a document using TAG technology.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF with system support.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current converted document version on the web or to readers.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Change content or properties of a released document, resulting in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group- or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign authors, co-authors, reviewers, releasers or translation participants in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Additional Information.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an Attachment.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Delete additional information directly due to lack of criticality.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an Attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves release of a document so it can be distributed and acted upon.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants immediately after first rejection.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: System informs involved users of status, workflow tasks, released versions, proposals, or other process information by email.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, automatically creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change Proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change Proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned Change Proposals directly in the Change Proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change Proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the Valid Until date.

evts.name: check_validity_extension
evts.description: Process a request for extended validity with workflow support by specified participants.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension, and update Valid Until.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for processing a request for AKS after attachment of the request.

evts.name: check_override
evts.description: Check AKS by releaser or through initiator, reviewer and releaser steps.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document and attachments invalid, give last valid approved version status Out of force, and revoke rights except archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for reactivation request.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, creating a new version of the document and restoring original status except version number and status.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document during reactivation.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain User Groups and persons assigned to Distribution for a document.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by email notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by email from persons and users of assigned User Groups upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement through workflow support without signature.

evts.name: summarize_acknowledgement
evts.description: Provide document author team an overview of acknowledgements not yet confirmed and notification when all are confirmed.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Assign corresponding documents in dashboards based on distribution groups in the distribution list.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Run role-specific evaluation reports and searches with selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content of the system into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated version so the document is visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition and reference the original document.

Documents assigned through distribution groups appear in dashboards.

A document can have translated language versions.
Workflow participants receive workflow tasks.
Workflow tasks are associated with document workflows.
Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released version of a document.
Audit trail functionality supports traceability for document approval processes.
Email notifications are sent to involved users, authors, co-authors, reviewers, releasers, recipients, or proposal creators.
